name: Rifat Sarwar
title: Backend Engineer
voice: I try to take my work seriously, but not myself. Love to code. Fueled by curiosity and occasional panic.
intro: I build backends that stay up, shrink ML models until they fit on modest hardware, and write software for machines that drive, grab and fly.
Right now I'm a Senior Software Engineer at Star Technologies, where I own backend architecture end to end, and I lead StarWatch, where we build drones from scratch.
